start_agent_service: start a tornado-based simultaneous translation server on a specified port with a given system
reset_system: reset the agent system state by sending a POST request to the /reset endpoint
push_input_segment: push an input segment to the agent system by sending a PUT request with JSON to the /input endpoint
pop_output_segment: pop and retrieve the next output segment from the agent system via a GET request to /output
get_system_info: retrieve system information as JSON by sending a GET request to the root endpoint
